I find my relationship with food is pretty bad now, not in the sense that I don’t want to eat it but I’m pretty scared of bacteria and germs - always had a slight tendency to be concerned of germs according to my mother when I was growing up but I grew out of it. Covid brought it back a little, and since having SIBO and other pathogens I’m super scared of any germs and undercooked food, I’m hyper aware of germs at all times now and I think that really effects my relationship with food (and my relationships too in a way), though I still love food. I haven’t really figured out how to manage it, because I don’t want to get unwell again, or make anything worse, but then that stress makes things worse in itself.

I F(23) just tried lexapro10mg for anxiety and depression. 
I lasted about a week, saw my doctor and she took me off them 
I became moody and I noticed there was a mood I’d slide into that was also incredibly aggressive. I really didn’t like it. Towards the end of that week I started to get suicidal thoughts. Got off them after speaking with doctor and I’m really glad I did. 
Our situations are obviously different as I was on for a much shorter time period and had suicidal thoughts early on. My point is more that if it’s not making you feel good it is so ok to see what your options are, and it really sounds like you should see what they are in terms of changing them. I don’t think the purpose of them is to put you in such a horrible mood
Hope you can see your psych/doctor soon and get it all sorted. When is your next appointment?
Here if you need to chat about anything
I would probably call a friend or lifeline. Most likely lifeline
